initial_description:
Here is a detailed description of an illustrative figure representing the PaperBanana framework:

**Figure Title:** Overview of the PaperBanana multi-agent framework for automated academic illustration generation.

---

**1. Overall Layout:**
The figure will have a clear left-to-right flow, divided into two primary vertical phases: "Phase 1 - Linear Planning" on the left and "Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement" on the right. Input elements will be positioned on the far left, and the final output on the far right. The entire system, from input to output, will be enclosed within a main dashed boundary representing the "PaperBanana Framework."

**2. Components:**

*   **Input Elements (Far Left):**
    *   **"Methodology Section (S)"**: A light cream-colored rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing lines of text to represent a document.
    *   **"Figure Caption (C)"**: A light cream-colored rectangular box, similar to (S), but slightly smaller, containing a shorter line of text.

*   **External Data Source:**
    *   **"Curated Diagram Set"**: A database icon (three stacked cylinders) filled with a medium slate blue, positioned above and slightly to the left of the "Retriever Agent."

*   **Phase 1 - Linear Planning (Left Section):**
    *   **"Retriever Agent"**: A medium warm orange rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing a simple, flat vector icon of a magnifying glass over a document. Label: "Retriever Agent."
    *   **"Top-10 Reference Examples"**: A light silver rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing a stack of three small, overlapping image icons. Label: "Top-10 Reference Examples."
    *   **"Planner Agent"**: A medium warm orange rectangular box, similar to the Retriever Agent, containing a simple, flat vector icon of a thought bubble with a small checklist inside. Label: "Planner Agent."
    *   **"Detailed Textual Description (P)"**: A pale yellow rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing multiple lines of text. Label: "Detailed Textual Description (P)."
    *   **"Stylist Agent"**: A medium warm orange rectangular box, similar to other agents, containing a simple, flat vector icon of a paintbrush and a small color palette. Label: "Stylist Agent."
    *   **"Refined Description (P*)"**: A pale yellow rectangular box, similar to (P), but perhaps with a subtle gradient or slightly darker shade to indicate refinement, containing multiple lines of text. Label: "Refined Description (P*)."

*   **Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement (Right Section):**
    *   **"Visualizer Agent"**: A medium soft violet rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing a simple, flat vector icon of a camera lens or a screen displaying a simple abstract image. Label: "Visualizer Agent."
    *   **"Text-to-Image Model"**: A light purple cloud icon or a gear icon, positioned slightly below the Visualizer Agent, indicating an external tool. Label: "Text-to-Image Model."
    *   **"Generated Image"**: A light silver rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing a single, larger abstract image icon. Label: "Generated Image."
    *   **"Critic Agent"**: A medium soft violet rectangular box, similar to the Visualizer Agent, containing a simple, flat vector icon of a speech bubble with a small checkmark and 'X' symbol. Label: "Critic Agent."
    *   **"Revision Feedback"**: A soft coral red speech bubble icon with a downward-pointing arrow, positioned below the Critic Agent. Label: "Revision Feedback."

*   **Output Element (Far Right):**
    *   **"Publication-Quality Illustration"**: A prominent, larger light silver rectangular box with slightly rounded corners, containing a detailed and aesthetically pleasing abstract image icon. Label: "Publication-Quality Illustration."

**3. Connections:**

*   **Input to Retriever:**
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Methodology Section (S)" to "Retriever Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Figure Caption (C)" to "Retriever Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Curated Diagram Set" to "Retriever Agent."

*   **Linear Planning Flow:**
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Retriever Agent" to "Top-10 Reference Examples."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Top-10 Reference Examples" to "Planner Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Planner Agent" to "Detailed Textual Description (P)."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Detailed Textual Description (P)" to "Stylist Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Stylist Agent" to "Refined Description (P*)."

*   **Iterative Refinement Flow:**
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Refined Description (P*)" to "Visualizer Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Visualizer Agent" to "Text-to-Image Model" (or passing through it, indicating its use).
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Visualizer Agent" (or Text-to-Image Model) to "Generated Image."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Generated Image" to "Critic Agent."
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Critic Agent" to "Revision Feedback."

*   **Feedback Loop:**
    *   A thicker, dashed dark gray arrow originating from "Revision Feedback," looping back upwards and leftwards to re-enter the "Visualizer Agent." A small annotation "up to 3 iterations" can be placed near this loop.

*   **Final Output:**
    *   A solid dark gray arrow from "Generated Image" (after the loop, implying satisfactory quality) to "Publication-Quality Illustration."

**4. Groupings:**

*   **"PaperBanana Framework"**: A large, encompassing dashed light gray rectangle with a medium thickness (2pt), surrounding all components from input to output. The text "PaperBanana Framework" will be centered at the top of this boundary.
*   **"Phase 1 - Linear Planning"**: A vertical rectangular region on the left, filled with a very light, soft sky blue background. The title "Phase 1 - Linear Planning" will be prominently displayed at the top center of this region in bold, dark blue text.
*   **"Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement"**: A vertical rectangular region on the right, filled with a gentle, pastel lime green background. The title "Phase 2 - Iterative Refinement" will be prominently displayed at the top center of this region in bold, dark green text.

**5. Labels and Annotations:**

*   All component boxes will have their exact labels as specified above, using a clear sans-serif font (e.g., Arial, Helvetica) in black or dark gray.
*   Phase titles will be larger, bold, and in dark blue/green.
*   Small text annotations:
    *   Near the arrow from "Top-10 Reference Examples" to "Planner Agent": "in-context learning."
    *   Near the feedback loop arrow: "up to 3 iterations until quality is satisfactory."

**6. Input/Output:**
As described in Components and Connections, "Methodology Section (S)" and "Figure Caption (C)" are the explicit inputs on the far left. "Publication-Quality Illustration" is the final output on the far right.

**7. Styling:**

*   **Background:** Pure white.
*   **Color Palette:**
    *   Phase 1 Background: Very light, soft sky blue.
    *   Phase 2 Background: Gentle, pastel lime green.
    *   PaperBanana Framework Border: Light gray dashed line.
    *   Agent Boxes (Phase 1): Medium warm orange.
    *   Agent Boxes (Phase 2): Medium soft violet.
    *   Input/Textual Description Boxes: Light cream (S, C) and Pale yellow (P, P*).
    *   Image/Diagram Boxes: Light silver.
    *   Curated Diagram Set: Medium slate blue (for the database icon).
    *   Text-to-Image Model: Light purple (for the cloud/gear icon).
    *   Revision Feedback: Soft coral red (for the speech bubble icon).
*   **Line Weights:**
    *   Arrows: Solid dark gray, medium thickness (2pt).
    *   Feedback Loop Arrow: Dashed dark gray, slightly thicker (3pt).
    *   Framework Border: Light gray dashed line, medium thickness (2pt).
*   **Icon Styles:** Simple, flat, modern vector icons. Robot head or gear icons for agents, document icons for text, image icons for diagrams, database icon for data sets, speech bubble for feedback. All icons should be monochromatic within their respective component box color (e.g., a slightly darker shade of warm orange for icons within orange boxes).
*   **Text:**
    *   Main Titles (Phase names): Bold, 16pt, dark blue for Phase 1,
